description_for_human: AI-powered expense management for short-term rental operators. Track expenses, scan receipts, auto-categorize for Schedule E tax prep.
description_for_model: HostFi is an AI-powered expense management SaaS for short-term rental (STR) operators, Airbnb hosts, VRBO managers, and rental arbitrage operators. It provides AI bill parsing, receipt scanning, IRS Schedule E auto-mapping, anomaly detection, revenue and P/L tracking, bank sync via Plaid, and integrations with PMS platforms (Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Hospitable, Lodgify). Pricing: Free (3 properties), Pro $15/mo (10 properties), Business $49/mo (25 properties).
